trial_court: Additional Senior Civil Judge, Srikakulam - MOP No.93 of 2018
case_name: Karasi Anupama vs Karasi Anil Kumar
facts_of_case: The petitioner is the wife and respondent is the husband. The case is about restitution of conjugal rights and interim maintenance. The trial court dismissed the interlocutory application for interim maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: A woman is entitled to lead a life in the similar manner as she would have lived in the house of her husband.
legal_principles.held: She is entitled in law to lead a life in the similar manner as she would have lived in the house of her husband.
cited_cases: Bhuwan Mohan Singh v. Meena and Ors, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The concept of sustenance does not necessarily mean to lead the life of an animal, feel like an unperson to be thrown away from grace and roam for her basic maintenance somewhere else.
legal_principles.held: She is entitled in law to lead a life in the similar manner as she would have lived in the house of her husband.
cited_cases: Bhuwan Mohan Singh v. Meena and Ors, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The husband cannot take subterfuges to deprive her of the benefits.
legal_principles.held: In a proceeding of this nature, the husband cannot take subterfuges to AIR 2014 Supreme Court 2875 deprive her of the benef
cited_cases: Bhuwan Mohan Singh v. Meena and Ors, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The notice sent to the respondent was presumed served, and the petitioner is entitled to interim maintenance.

keywords: Latin maxim: Actus me invito non facit actum
